messages:
Olivia Z: hit a weird loop after upgrading redwoodctl. Installer said 'migrated profiles' but `redwoodctl login` keeps prompting for interactive accept even after device flow succeeds.
Hector M: paste the flow/logs?
Olivia Z: sequence: run `redwoodctl init --profile demo` then `redwoodctl login --profile demo --method device`. Browser shows success, CLI shows "waiting for token..." then times out and then next login attempt says "token exists" but API calls still 401.
Benji: could be a profile-name collision with the system default and our credential helper storing to a different path. what's `redwoodctl config get --profile demo`?
Olivia Z: output (redacted):
```
endpoint: https://auth.redwood.ai
credential_store: file
credential_path: /home/olivia/.cache/redwood/creds/demo.json
```
Benji: and the helper? `which redwood-cred-helper` shows `/usr/local/bin/redwood-cred-helper`?
Olivia Z: yes. But the file at credential_path is stale (old token) and helper didn't overwrite because file perms were 600 and owned by root after an earlier sudo run.
Hector M: ahh sudo'd installer edge-case. Installer wrote creds as root when run with sudo and now unprivileged CLI can't refresh. We should detect owned-by-root and surface a clear error.
Olivia Z: I fixed by `sudo chown $USER:$USER /home/olivia/.cache/redwood/creds/demo.json` and then login worked immediately. But this is a nasty onboarding trap.
DevEx Bot: created DEVEX-2350 "installer: do not write credential files as root when run with sudo; warn and refuse" (link)
cli-bot: Suggestion: add a preflight that checks creds dir ownership and prints a helpful hint: "detected root-owned credential files; run chown or reinstall without sudo".
Benji: also add installer guardrail: if run under sudo, print a big warning and refuse unless `--allow-sudo` is provided. Many users accidentally sudo the curl|sh.
Hector M: plus add a small unit test to simulate sudo-installed creds and ensure CLI surfaces clear remediation.
Olivia Z: will add the onboarding note and ping workshop leads. thanks :clap:
